comparison.objective: Identify, orient, and vacuum-mount a semiconductor wafer, not separate media.
comparison.physical_skill: Edge-safe tweezer handling and flat-based orientation versus bimanual granular flow.
comparison.success_condition: Correct wafer centered, flat-aligned, vacuum enabled, and hands withdrawn; no screening outcome.
comparison.reason: Fragile planar mounting tests a different ability. Spec versions refine the wafer keep-out region but remain sufficient.
